prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one wide 16:9 PIXEL ART game-background candidate for a computer/software/technology voiceover explainer channel.
Primary request: visibly authentic pixel-game illustration, with a polished mature art direction and a computing-related setting. The PIXEL ART medium is mandatory. Make it unmistakably drawn in pixels at a glance, even as a thumbnail.
Style/medium: exquisite hand-placed 2D pixel art in the tradition of sophisticated 16/32-bit game backgrounds, native 480x270 canvas appearance enlarged with nearest-neighbor sampling. Clearly visible square pixel clusters and crisp stepped edges, coherent pixel grid, controlled 32-48 color ramps, light tasteful dithering, pixel-painted light and reflections. No anti-aliased smooth contours, no smooth gradients, no photographic textures, no photorealism, no 3D render, no cinematic photography, no vector art. Detailed but deliberate pixel shapes, not a photograph with a pixel filter. Slight depth in a game environment, no fisheye camera.
Composition: full environmental background only, wide landscape. Computing scenery is mainly at left/right margins and upper third, with a calm but designed middle area for later explanation text, code and diagrams, and low-detail lower 18 percent for subtitles. Keep the center integrated with the actual room or space, not an empty black rectangle or a blank real-estate wall. Dark, rich and refined, beautiful restrained local cyan/amber/violet illumination, readable silhouettes and good spatial layering. No protagonist is necessary.
Constraints: NO people, faces, characters, game HUD, game menu, score counters, health bars, quest icons, floating UI cards, readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, border, panels of a contact sheet or collage. No urban city skyline, skyscrapers, city streets, fantasy ruins, medieval castles, monsters or giant hero object in center. No RGB gaming-chair room, no blinding laser lights, no monotonous black fill. One self-contained pixel-illustrated background, fully opaque.
Scene: a warm late-night developer's workshop depicted entirely as pixel art. A walnut workbench runs low across the frame, small retro computer and neatly organized tools at the extreme left, an articulated amber lamp and tiny potted plant at right, muted shelves and technical equipment frame the edges. The central navy room wall has interesting broad pixel shading and recessed structure but remains quiet for overlays. Palette: indigo, warm walnut, golden lamp light and small cyan computer highlights. Cozy, focused and refined, no city outside.
